name: Hayamoto Kanjiro
source:
"That big nose of the Moai statue... isn't it really beautiful?"

He received attention as a next-generation archery prospect in his middle school's archery club, and entered Hope's Peak Academy as a high school student. When he shoots at any target, he shows 100% skill.

Even in normal times, he enjoys wearing an archery suit because it is his most comfortable outfit, and at first glance, he is sometimes mistaken for a woman because of his unusual outfit and beautiful appearance.

He is quite tall and has all the elements of a pretty boy, but inside of him, he has four-dimensional thoughts. He is particularly interested in aliens and moai statues.
